grade.basis: Violin 1 and 2 sit in very high positions (sustained d''' to a''' with 4th-finger shifts, Nachtzauber parts PDF pp.27-30); Elfenreigen violin 1 is lively scherzo with leaps to e''' (PDF pp.3-8). grade.basis: Mostly crotchets and minims within first-position-to-fourth range in bass clef; piece I is four-beat crotchets (PDF pp.1-3); VII adds quavers and sixteenth scale figures in cello 3-4 at Allegro (pp.20-23). No clef changes, shifts are stepwise.

workCorrections.notes: Four-movement consort; this entry is the four-violin version of a work also allowed for violas or cellos.

grade.basis: Toccata (Virtuoso, quarter=100) is nonstop chromatic sixteenth runs and leaps in every part for about 19 bars, in canon (PDF pp.1-2); finale bariolage at dotted quarter=150 in 6/8 over string crossings (pp.11-12). Pitch range stays in low positions, so speed and chromatic accuracy set the level.

recordingDecisions.reason: Score-only video; human performance and violin scoring not shown
